title: DOW-UAP-D100, Air Materiel Command Report on Unidentified Flying Objects, 1947-1948
doc_notes: This document is a collection of U.S. Government memoranda and correspondence relating to Project Sign, an Air Force program to investigate UAP reports from 1947-1948.

incidents.summary: Observation of a yellow sphere, 25-40 feet in diameter, near Anacostia Naval Air Station.
incidents.quote: The object resembled a yellow sphere estimated at 25-40 feet in diameter.

incidents.summary: Report of a strange object in the night sky that moved, stopped, and changed course.
incidents.quote: this "thing" moved across the sky then stopped for about 8 seconds then changed its course

incidents.summary: Sighting of a round, phosphorescent object at high altitude.
incidents.quote: round, phosphorescent trail in the sky
